Career Aspiration: Results-driven Business Analyst with 11 years of total experience and 6 years of experience in the Banking, 
methodologies, with strong expertise 
 • Experienced Business Analyst in delivering Digital Transformation initiatives across the Banking, Cards, Lending, and Wealth Management, Insurance (BFSI) domain in Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies. • Strong domain expertise in Retail Banking, Digital Banking, Internet Banking, Cards & Payments, Loan Origination (LOS), Loan Servicing, Wealth Management, Insurance Policy Administration, Risk & Compliance, and customer-centric digital solutions.
Sound understanding of banking, lending, and insurance products, Core Banking Systems (CBS), CRM,
regulatory compliance, and end-to-end digital customer journeys.
Proven ability to bridge business needs with technology solutions by collaborating with business
stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver value-driven outcomes.
Visa Scheme & Regulatory Compliance: Worked hands-on on Visa scheme requirements, regulatory updates and payment/card-related mandates, assessing their business and system impact and translating them into functional requirements and implementation changes.
Regulatory Control Framework: Supported the definition, implementation and maintenance of regulatory control frameworks for card/payment processes, ensuring business processes, system workflows and controls remained aligned with applicable regulatory and scheme requirements.
Risk & Control Assessment: Performed risk and control assessments, identifying regulatory/process gaps, evaluating control effectiveness, documenting remediation requirements and coordinating with business, technology and compliance stakeholders.
Regulatory Impact & Gap Analysis: Conducted regulatory impact and gap analysis for Visa and banking regulatory changes, mapping requirements to existing processes/systems and defining changes required for compliance.
Control Testing & Validation: Supported/participated in control testing and compliance validation, reviewing test results and evidence to confirm that regulatory and Visa scheme requirements were correctly implemented.
Regulatory Implementation: Translated regulatory and Visa scheme changes into country-specific/localized business requirements, process changes and system enhancements, supporting SIT/UAT, defect resolution and production implementation.
Hands-on experience across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement elicitation and analysis to solution delivery, testing, deployment, and production support.
Proficient in preparing BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Use Cases, Process Flow Diagrams, Functional Specifications, RTMs, and Wireframes.
Experienced in facilitating requirement workshops, backlog refinement, sprint planning, functional walkthroughs, and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring seamless collaboration between business and technology teams.
Partnered with UI/UX Designers, Solution Architects, Developers, and QA teams to design, develop, test, and implement business solutions that align with organizational objectives.
Supported test planning, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, release validation, and post- production support to ensure successful project delivery.
Proficient in Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Visio, Draw.io, Balsamiq, and Microsoft Office Suite for requirements management, process modelling, collaboration, and project documentation.
Strong analytical, stakeholder management, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and deliver measurable business outcomes.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience: 1) Deutsche Bank- Senior Business Analyst (Duration: Aug 2020 to till now). Senior Business Analyst – End to End Digitalization of Credit Card Issuance (Card Origination), Card Servicing functionalities, Enhancement and optimization of Features in Digital Banking Initiatives like Account Servicing, Deposits Enrichment, Cards Servicing, Loans Servicing, Policy Servicing – Straight Through Processing (STP) Journeys. Digital Lending – Digitalization of retail loan journeys (Loan Origination System), Policy Origination & Policy administration services for Insurance products. Wealth Management – Customer Onboarding Journeys ISA A/c (Investment Services A/c), Servicing journeys.
Key Roles & Responsibilities: • Acted as a strategic liaison between Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, IT Development, QA, and Vendor teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and alignment throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using both Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies.
Partnered with cross-functional business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, validate, and prioritize business requirements, translating them into well-defined Epics, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria using Jira.
Produced comprehensive business and functional documentation
including Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), User Stories, Use Cases, Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM), Process Flows, and Functional Specifications.
Leveraged Jira and Confluence to manage product backlogs, maintain project documentation, track requirement traceability, and facilitate collaboration across business and technology teams.
Conducted stakeholder workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, and business process assessments to identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and digital transformation across Retail Banking and Digital Banking platforms.
Performed GAP Analysis and documented AS-IS and TO-BE business processes using process flow diagrams and wireframes, enabling stakeholders to visualize solution design and future-state processes.
Collaborated closely with Solution Architects, Development, QA, and Vendor teams to clarify functional requirements, resolve business queries, and ensure successful delivery of business solutions.
Facilitated knowledge transfer (KT) sessions and walkthroughs of business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories for Development and Quality Assurance teams to ensure a common understanding of project objectives.
Owned and continuously refined the Product Backlog by prioritizing user stories, managing change requests, and supporting release planning in collaboration with Product Owners and business stakeholders.
Actively participated in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure timely delivery and continuous improvement.
Provided regular project status updates to business stakeholders and senior management, highlighting risks, dependencies, issue resolution, release readiness, and change request progress.
Coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios, reviewing test cases, supporting business users during execution, managing defect resolution, and obtaining business sign-off prior to production deployment.
Supported successful implementation and post-production validation of new features and enhancements by collaborating with business users, technology teams, and support teams to ensure smooth business adoption.
2) Deutsche Bank – Private Banking Relationship Manager (Duration: Apr 2019 to Jul 2020). Private Banking Relationship Manager – Managed a portfolio of HNI/UHNI clients by delivering personalized wealth management, investment advisory, portfolio optimization, and financial planning solutions, client retention, and revenue generation. Key Roles & Responsibilities: • Advised clients on diversified investment and wealth management products including Mutual Funds, Equities, Bonds, Structured Products, Insurance, Fixed Income Securities, and Retirement Planning solutions based on their risk profile and investment horizon.
Conducted periodic portfolio reviews, investment performance analysis, and financial planning discussions to optimize portfolio allocation, strengthen client engagement, and improve client retention.
Managed end-to-end execution of high-value investment transactions while ensuring operational accuracy, timely processing, and an exceptional client experience.
Ensured strict adherence to regulatory and compliance frameworks by maintaining high standards in KYC, AML, FATCA, investment suitability assessments, documentation, and internal audit requirements.
Collaborated with Investment Advisors, Treasury, Credit, Product, Operations, and Compliance teams to design integrated financial solutions that addressed clients' investment, lending, insurance, and wealth preservation needs.
Leveraged client feedback and service analytics to identify process improvement opportunities, enhancing service quality, operational efficiency, client satisfaction, and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
Monitored market trends, economic developments, and regulatory changes to provide timely investment insights and proactive portfolio recommendations, enabling clients to make informed financial decisions. • Consistently delivered superior client experience by combining relationship management expertise, financial advisory capabilities, and operational excellence to drive long-term client loyalty and business growth. Previous Work Experience: • Worked as Wealth Manager at Globe Capital Ltd during Jan 2018 to Apr 2019. • Worked as Senior Relationship Manager at ICICI Securities during July 2015 to Oct 2017.
